verdict.rationale: Cooley publishes a named, firm-owned AI company (Cooley AI) that connects AI to the firm's knowledge and workflows for client service. It also describes a concrete AI use case: drafting a bespoke S-1 in minutes and updating it through prompts. This goes beyond a bare mention, but it is still presented as promotional copy rather than a transparent account of how AI is used with clients. Missing for 10: published AI-use or governance policies, named underlying tools or vendors, detail on how clients access or experience the AI products, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
